release_notes: Growth Autopilot now creates or reuses public YouTube category playlists such as Science Quizzes and automatically adds each newly scheduled full quiz to the matching playlist.
Long-form quizzes keep the zero-second opening so Question 1 starts immediately instead of spending viewer retention on an intro.
Full quizzes now finish on a stable 15-second end-screen-safe card with dedicated Next Quiz and Quiz Playlist areas instead of spinning away at the end.
Playlist failures are non-blocking: the quiz stays scheduled and the app reports the playlist problem without stopping the rest of Autopilot.
Existing Autopilot release preparation still creates promos, tracking links and website releases and prepares YouTube/Facebook promo scheduling.
